literature.headline_zh: 人腺病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人腺病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在抑制CME的A549细胞中,HAdV-D26感染通过TLR3–TICAM1–p38依赖机制部分诱导IL-6表达。抑制TLR3或p38,以及敲低TICAM1,均降低了在CME抑制条件下观察到的IL-6升高反应。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11278287/v1]
传统的细菌指示物并不能准确反映与病毒病原体相关的危害。水体质量和食品安全之间存在明确的联系,因为受污染的水源,尤其是用于灌溉和收获后处理的表层水,是病毒传播到新鲜农产品和贝类的重要途径。 [10.68263/bjar-hxfmvxvp]
在 60/632 (9.5%) 儿童中检测到乳腺病毒,其中 1-3 岁儿童的阳性率最高。合并感染主要涉及细菌病原体。系统发育分析鉴定出两个 HAdV-F4​​0 和三个 HAdV-F4​​1 分离株。 [10.1186/s12866-026-05633-0]

本次队列研究中,255名患者中188名(73.7%)检出MP,其中6~11岁感染率最高,达84.0%。主要的共同病原体是肺炎链球菌、流感嗜血杆菌、人腺病毒、人博卡病毒和鼻病毒。与非 MP 组相比,MP 感染患者的 Shannon 和 Simpson 指数显着降低(p < 0.001),微生物物种均匀度降低。微生物组分析揭示了 MP 感染儿童呼吸道微生物组的变化。年龄分层微生物分析表明,肺部微生物α多样性随着年龄的增长而逐渐增加,总微生物负荷与年龄呈弱正相关(R = 0.17,p = 0.0055)。 [10.3389/fcimb.2026.1955999]

在 569/630 (90.3%) 个样本中鉴定出 NHP 物种。在 10/569 (1.76%) 样本中检测到腺病毒 DNA,其中 3 个来自 Cercopithecus ascanius,6 个来自 Cercopithecus Wolfi,1 个来自 Lophocebus aterrimus。Wolfi 衍生的序列形成了一个独特的单系簇(77% bootstrap 支持),而三个 ascanius 衍生的序列聚集在 HAdV-41 参考序列附近。在人类中,9/221 (4.1%) 粪便样本中检测到了腺病毒 DNA。 [10.1186/s12985-026-03357-1]

literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: In CME-inhibited A549 cells, HAdV-D26 infection induced IL-6 expression partially through a TLR3–TICAM1–p38-dependent mechanism. Inhibition of TLR3 or p38, as well as knockdown of TICAM1, reduced the elevated IL-6 response observed under CME inhibition. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11278287/v1]
Traditional bacterial indicators do not accurately reflect the hazards associated with viral pathogens. [10.68263/bjar-hxfmvxvp]

Mastadenoviruses were detected in 60/632 (9.5%) children, with the highest positivity observed among those aged 1-3 years. Co-infections occurred predominantly involving bacterial pathogens. Phylogenetic analyses identified two HAdV-F40 and three HAdV-F41 isolates. [10.1186/s12866-026-05633-0]

In this cohort, MP was detected in 188 of 255 patients (73.7%), with the highest infection rate of 84.0% in those aged 6–11 years. The predominant co-pathogens were Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, human adenovirus, human bocavirus, and rhinovirus. [10.3389/fcimb.2026.1955999]

NHP species were identified in 569/630 (90.3%) samples. Adenovirus DNA was detected in 10/569 (1.76%) samples, including three from Cercopithecus ascanius, six from Cercopithecus wolfi, and one from Lophocebus aterrimus. [10.1186/s12985-026-03357-1]

papers.title: TLR3–TICAM1–p38 signalling partially mediates IL-6 induction during human adenovirus type 26 infection in epithelial cells with inhibited clathrin-mediated endocytosis
papers.abstract: Abstract Human adenovirus type 26 (HAdV-D26) is a clinically important vector, but the connection between its entry pathway, intracellular trafficking, and innate immune sensing remains unclear. As innate immune sensors are distributed throughout the cell, the virus entry route and subcellular localization likely shape immune activation. Here, we investigated how altered entry routes and endosomal retention of HAdV-D26 influence Toll-like receptor (TLR)-mediated signalling in epithelial cells. Using A549 cells with inhibited clathrin-mediated endocytosis (CME) or de novo αvβ3 integrin expression, we analysed IL-6 and IL-8 expression following HAdV-D26 infection and examined the underlying signalling mechanisms. In CME-inhibited A549 cells, where HAdV-D26 persisted longer in early endosomes, HAdV-D26 infection induced IL-6 expression partially through a TLR3–TICAM1–p38-dependent mechanism. Inhibition of TLR3 or p38, as well as knockdown of TICAM1, reduced the elevated IL-6 response observed under CME inhibition. In contrast, inhibition of TLR4 or knockdown of MyD88 increased HAdV-D26-induced IL-6 and IL-8 expression in A549 cells, indicating a negative regulatory role of TLR4–MyD88 signalling. Furthermore, MyD88 knockdown reduced IL-8 expression in A549 cells with de novo αvβ3 integrin expression, linking integrin-mediated entry to MyD88-dependent signalling. In conclusion, these findings highlight how entry pathway and intracellular localization shape innate immune sensing of adenoviral vectors.

analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro experiments using A549 cells, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence is strong as it directly links HAdV-D26 entry pathways to specific immune responses through targeted molecular interventions.

papers.title_zh: TLR3–TICAM1–p38信号通路部分介导人腺病毒型26在抑制网格蛋白介导的内吞作用的上皮细胞中诱导IL-6
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Human adenovirus type 26 (HAdV-D26) is a clinically important vector, but the connection between its entry pathway, intracellular trafficking, and innate immune sensing remains unclear. As innate immune sensors are distributed throughout the cell, the virus entry route and subcellular localization likely shape immune activation. Here, we investigated how altered entry routes and endosomal retention of HAdV-D26 influence Toll-like receptor (TLR)-mediated signalling in epithelial cells. Using A549 cells with inhibited clathrin-mediated endocytosis (CME) or de novo αvβ3 integrin expression, we analysed IL-6 and IL-8 expression following HAdV-D26 infection and examined the underlying signalling mechanisms. In CME-inhibited A549 cells, where HAdV-D26 persisted longer in early endosomes, HAdV-D26 infection induced IL-6 expression partially through a TLR3–TICAM1–p38-dependent mechanism. Inhibition of TLR3 or p38, as well as knockdown of TICAM1, reduced the elevated IL-6 response observed under CME inhibition. In contrast, inhibition of TLR4 or knockdown of MyD88 increased HAdV-D26-induced IL-6 and IL-8 expression in A549 cells, indicating a negative regulatory role of TLR4–MyD88 signalling. Furthermore, MyD88 knockdown reduced IL-8 expression in A549 cells with de novo αvβ3 integrin expression, linking integrin-mediated entry to MyD88-dependent signalling. In conclusion, these findings highlight how entry pathway and intracellular localization shape innate immune sensing of adenoviral vectors.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 人腺病毒型26(HAdV-D26)是一种临床重要的媒介,但其进入途径、细胞内运输与先天免疫感知之间的联系尚不清楚。由于先天免疫传感器广泛分布于细胞中,病毒进入途径和亚细胞定位可能影响免疫激活。本研究探讨了HAdV-D26进入途径改变和内体滞留如何影响上皮细胞中Toll样受体(TLR)介导的信号传导。使用抑制网格蛋白介导的内吞作用(CME)或新表达αvβ3整合素的A549细胞,我们分析了HAdV-D26感染后IL-6和IL-8的表达,并研究了其潜在的信号传导机制。在抑制CME的A549细胞中,HAdV-D26感染通过TLR3–TICAM1–p38依赖机制部分诱导IL-6表达。抑制TLR3或p38,以及敲低TICAM1,均降低了在CME抑制条件下观察到的IL-6升高反应。相反,抑制TLR4或敲低MyD88则增加了HAdV-D26诱导的IL-6和IL-8表达,表明TLR4–MyD88信号传导具有负调控作用。此外,在新表达αvβ3整合素的A549细胞中,敲低MyD88降低了IL-8的表达,将整合素介导的进入与MyD88依赖的信号传导联系起来。总之,这些发现强调了HAdV-D26进入途径和细胞内定位如何影响其先天免疫感知。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨人腺病毒型26(HAdV-D26)进入途径改变和内体滞留如何影响上皮细胞中Toll样受体(TLR)介导的信号传导。背景指出HAdV-D26进入途径、细胞内运输与先天免疫感知之间的联系尚不明确。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用抑制网格蛋白介导的内吞作用(CME)或新表达αvβ3整合素的A549细胞,以分析HAdV-D26感染后IL-6和IL-8的表达,并研究其潜在的信号传导机制。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过抑制A549细胞中的网格蛋白介导的内吞作用或引入新表达的αvβ3整合素,随后评估HAdV-D26感染后IL-6和IL-8的表达,并探索相关的信号传导通路。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在抑制CME的A549细胞中,HAdV-D26感染通过TLR3–TICAM1–p38依赖机制部分诱导IL-6表达。抑制TLR3或p38,以及敲低TICAM1,均降低了在CME抑制条件下观察到的IL-6升高反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明HAdV-D26的进入途径和细胞内定位显著影响其先天免疫感知,揭示了IL-6诱导的TLR3–TICAM1–p38依赖机制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了关于腺病毒媒介进入途径如何影响免疫激活的见解,这可能有助于优化媒介设计并减少基因治疗应用中意外的免疫应答。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于使用A549细胞进行体外实验,可能无法完全代表体内情况。证据强度较高,因为它通过针对性的分子干预直接将HAdV-D26的进入途径与特定的免疫应答联系起来。

papers.title: A Confirmatory, Dual Center Nonhuman Primate Study on the Efficacy of Novel Oropharyngeal Spray Immunization With an Adenoviral Vector Vaccine Against RSV-Important Lessons Learned.
papers.abstract: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Methods Rhesus macaques received an RSV fusion protein (F) DNA vaccine via electroporation, followed by two mucosal administrations of a recombinant adenovirus vector encoding the same antigen. Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. Conclusion Our results support the potential of mucosal adenoviral boosting following DNA priming to induce protective immunity against RSV, while highlighting challenges associated with multi-center preclinical vaccine studies.

Control groups included mock-vaccinated animals and those mimicking natural immunity from primary RSV infection. The study observed robust immune responses but noted variability between centers. papers.title: Coliphages and Human Adenoviruses as Viral Indicators of Faecal Contamination in Water: A Critical Review of Environmental Occurrence, Detection Methods, and Public Health Risk with Implications for Food Safety in Nigeria
papers.abstract: This review synthesises current knowledge on the role of viral indicators, specifically coliphages and human adenoviruses (HAdVs), for assessing faecal contamination in water. It aims to bridge environmental monitoring and food safety perspectives by evaluating the occurrence, detection, and public health implications of these viral contaminants across water matrices, with implications for food production systems. Traditional bacterial indicators do not accurately reflect the hazards associated with viral pathogens. While HAdVs have become reliable markers of faecal pollution due to their high environmental stability, global prevalence, and presence in sewage, coliphages show environmental stability comparable to enteric viruses and are becoming more widely recognised for source tracking. Probabilistic estimation of infection risks from aquatic viruses is now possible thanks to quantitative microbial risk assessment (QMRA) frameworks. There is a clear connection between water quality and food safety since polluted water sources, especially surface water utilised for irrigation and post-harvest processing, act as vital vectors for virus transmission to fresh produce and shellfish. Predicting public health threats accurately requires including viral markers in regular water quality monitoring. Standardising procedures and increasing environmental surveillance should be the top priorities in future initiatives to reduce viral exposures from food and water in Nigeria.

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管HAdVs由于其高环境稳定性、全球分布以及在污水中的存在,已成为粪便污染的可靠标志物,但肠道噬菌体的环境稳定性与肠道病毒相当,并正逐渐被广泛认可用于污染源追踪。由于定量微生物风险评估(QMRA)框架的发展,现在可以对水生病毒引起的感染风险进行概率性估计。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了准确预测公共卫生威胁,应在常规水质监测中纳入病毒标志物。未来减少尼日利亚食品和水源中病毒暴露的倡议应将标准化程序和增加环境监测作为首要任务。

papers.title: Whole-genome characterization and genomic stability of Mastadenovirus F40 and F41 in pediatric gastroenteritis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Human adenovirus types 40 and 41 (HAdV-40 and HAdV-41), belonging to the species Mastadenovirus faecale, are among the leading viral causes of acute gastroenteritis in children. Despite their clinical importance, whole-genome data on circulating strains remain limited. This study investigated the epidemiological and genomic characteristics of enteric Mastadenoviruses detected in children with acute gastroenteritis. METHODS: A total of 632 stool specimens collected from hospitalized children with acute gastroenteritis were screened using a multiplex gastrointestinal real-time PCR panel. Five representative Mastadenovirus-positive samples underwent shotgun metagenomic sequencing followed by genome reconstruction, phylogenetic analysis, pairwise sequence identity comparisons, genome-wide variant analysis, amino acid substitution profiling, and recombination analysis. RESULTS: Mastadenoviruses were detected in 60/632 (9.5%) children, with the highest positivity observed among those aged 1-3 years. Co-infections occurred predominantly involving bacterial pathogens. Complete or near-complete genomes were recovered for all five sequenced isolates with high sequencing depth (2,806 × -34,120 ×), genome coverage (94.8%-100% at ≥ 10 ×), and nucleotide identity (99.19%-99.78%) relative to genotype-matched reference genomes. Phylogenetic analyses identified two HAdV-F40 and three HAdV-F41 isolates. Gene-specific phylogenies of the hexon, penton base, fiber, and DNA polymerase genes consistently confirmed genotype assignment. Pairwise sequence identity analysis and recombination analysis further supported classification with no evidence of intergenotypic recombination. CONCLUSIONS: The sequenced enteric Mastadenovirus isolates exhibited high genomic conservation with limited within-genotype diversity and no detectable evidence of recent recombination. The concordance between gene-specific phylogenies, sequence identity analyses, and whole-genome comparisons supports the robustness of current molecular typing approaches and expands the limited genomic data available for circulating HAdV-F40 and HAdV-F41 strains.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Human adenovirus types 40 and 41 (HAdV-40 and HAdV-41), belonging to the species Mastadenovirus faecale, are among the leading viral causes of acute gastroenteritis in children. Despite their clinical importance, whole-genome data on circulating strains remain limited. This study investigated the epidemiological and genomic characteristics of enteric Mastadenoviruses detected in children with acute gastroenteritis. METHODS: A total of 632 stool specimens collected from hospitalized children with acute gastroenteritis were screened using a multiplex gastrointestinal real-time PCR panel. Five representative Mastadenovirus-positive samples underwent shotgun metagenomic sequencing followed by genome reconstruction, phylogenetic analysis, pairwise sequence identity comparisons, genome-wide variant analysis, amino acid substitution profiling, and recombination analysis. RESULTS: Mastadenoviruses were detected in 60/632 (9.5%) children, with the highest positivity observed among those aged 1-3 years. Co-infections occurred predominantly involving bacterial pathogens. Complete or near-complete genomes were recovered for all five sequenced isolates with high sequencing depth (2,806 × -34,120 ×), genome coverage (94.8%-100% at ≥ 10 ×), and nucleotide identity (99.19%-99.78%) relative to genotype-matched reference genomes. Phylogenetic analyses identified two HAdV-F40 and three HAdV-F41 isolates. Gene-specific phylogenies of the hexon, penton base, fiber, and DNA polymerase genes consistently confirmed genotype assignment. Pairwise sequence identity analysis and recombination analysis further supported classification with no evidence of intergenotypic recombination. CONCLUSIONS: The sequenced enteric Mastadenovirus isolates exhibited high genomic conservation with limited within-genotype diversity and no detectable evidence of recent recombination. The concordance between gene-specific phylogenies, sequence identity analyses, and whole-genome comparisons supports the robustness of current molecular typing approaches and expands the limited genomic data available for circulating HAdV-F40 and HAdV-F41 strains.

papers.title: Genetic diversity of adenoviruses in humans and wild non-human primates from the Mabali Reserve (DRC), including a divergent adenovirus cluster in Cercopithecus wolfi
papers.abstract: Adenoviruses exhibit substantial genetic diversity in humans and non-human primates (NHPs), yet their occurrence in wild African primates remains incompletely documented. We performed adenovirus DNA detection and genetic diversity in wild NHPs and humans living around the Mabali Forest Reserve, Democratic Republic of Congo, within a One Health framework. We analyzed 630 NHP fecal samples collected in December 2023 and 221 human stool samples from febrile individuals collected in July 2025. NHP species were identified by mitochondrial 16 S rRNA gene sequencing. Adenovirus DNA was screened by qPCR targeting the hexon gene and characterized by partial DNA polymerase gene sequencing and amino acid-based phylogenetic analysis. NHP species were identified in 569/630 (90.3%) samples. Adenovirus DNA was detected in 10/569 (1.76%) samples, including three from Cercopithecus ascanius , six from C. wolfi , and one from Lophocebus aterrimus . wolfi -derived sequences formed a distinct monophyletic cluster (77% bootstrap support), whereas three C. ascanius -derived sequences clustered near the HAdV-41 reference sequence. In humans, adenovirus DNA was detected in 9/221 (4.1%) stool samples. Human-derived sequences showed genetic affinities with several human adenovirus reference types. The phylogenetic analysis was based on 76 amino acid positions, limiting the resolution of evolutionary relationships. These findings document adenovirus DNA in humans and several wild NHP species, including a distinct phylogenetic cluster associated with C. Although genetic affinities with reference adenoviruses were observed, the available data do not establish recent cross-species transmission between the sampled populations. Further genomic characterization and longitudinal surveillance are needed to clarify adenovirus diversity and evolutionary relationships at the human-wildlife interface.

papers.title: Lower respiratory tract microbiome during the 2023–2024 pediatric Mycoplasma pneumoniae epidemic: age-specific microbial shifts, macrolide resistance, and co-infection profiles
papers.abstract: Objective Recurrent outbreaks of macrolide-resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) pneumonia pose substantial health risks to children. This study aimed to characterize the demographic–epidemiological features of pediatric MP pneumonia during 2023–2024 and to explore macrolide-resistance mutations, co-infecting pathogens, and age-specific disturbances in the lower-respiratory-tract microbiome. Methods A single-center retrospective study was conducted based on 255 bronchoalveolar lavage fluid metagenomic next-generation sequencing samples collected from hospitalized children diagnosed with pneumonia at Peking University First Hospital from June 1, 2023 to May 31, 2024. All enrolled cases were divided into MP-positive/-negative and age‐stratified subgroups to compare demographic features, pathogen distribution, and respiratory microbial diversity. Results In this cohort, MP was detected in 188 of 255 patients (73.7%), with the highest infection rate of 84.0% in those aged 6–11 years. Epidemiological seasonal analysis showed that MP prevalence peaked in autumn at 91.7%, followed by winter with a prevalence of 75.6%. Among all MP-positive specimens, 73.4% (138/188) harbored macrolide-resistant 23S rRNA A2063G mutation. The highest proportion was observed in the 6–11 age group (101/131, 77.1%). The predominant co-pathogens were Streptococcus pneumoniae , Haemophilus influenzae , human adenovirus, human bocavirus, and rhinovirus. Compared with the non-MP group, patients with MP infection presented markedly lower Shannon and Simpson indices ( p < 0.001) and decreased microbial species evenness. Microbiome analysis revealed alterations in the respiratory microbiome in MP-infected children. Age-stratified microbial analysis demonstrated that pulmonary microbial α-diversity increased progressively with age and total microbial burden was weakly positively correlated with age ( R = 0.17, p = 0.0055). Children aged under 3 years were predominantly colonized with Streptococcus species and multiple respiratory viruses, whereas adolescents aged 12–18 years harbored higher levels of commensal microbes including Cutibacterium acnes and Prevotella species. Conclusions The 2023–2024 MP epidemic predominantly affected school-aged children aged 6–11 years accompanied with a high prevalence of 23S rRNA A2063G macrolide resistance. MP-infected children exhibited reduced microbial diversity. The pediatric lower respiratory microbiome exhibited distinct age-dependent variations in diversity, microbial load, and community composition. The study provides age-specific evidence for diagnosis, anti-infective strategy formulation, and microbiome intervention of pediatric MP pneumonia.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 耐大环内酯类肺炎支原体 (MP) 肺炎的复发 暴发 对儿童构成重大健康风险。本研究旨在描述 2023 年至 2024 年小儿 MP 肺炎的人口统计学-流行病学特征,并探讨大环内酯类药物耐药性 突变、共同感染病原体以及下呼吸道微生物组的年龄特异性紊乱。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究基于2023年6月1日至2024年5月31日北京大学第一医院收治的肺炎住院患儿255例支气管肺泡灌洗液宏基因组二代测序样本进行单中心回顾性研究。将所有入组病例分为MP阳性/阴性和年龄分层亚组,比较人口学特征、病原菌分布和呼吸道微生物多样性。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究利用支气管肺泡灌洗液样本的宏基因组下一代测序来分析下呼吸道微生物组。它比较了 MP 阳性组和 MP 阴性组以及按年龄分层的亚组,以评估人口特征、病原体分布和微生物多样性。
elements_zh.main_results: 本次队列研究中,255名患者中188名(73.7%)检出MP,其中6~11岁感染率最高,达84.0%。主要的共同病原体是肺炎链球菌、流感嗜血杆菌、人腺病毒、人博卡病毒和鼻病毒。与非 MP 组相比,MP 感染患者的 Shannon 和 Simpson 指数显着降低(p < 0.001),微生物物种均匀度降低。微生物组分析揭示了 MP 感染儿童呼吸道微生物组的变化。年龄分层微生物分析表明,肺部微生物α多样性随着年龄的增长而逐渐增加,总微生物负荷与年龄呈弱正相关(R = 0.17,p = 0.0055)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,2023-2024 年 MP 流行主要影响 6-11 岁的学龄儿童,且 患病率 对 23S rRNA A2063G 大环内酯类药物具有较高的耐药性。该研究为小儿MP肺炎的诊断、抗感染策略制定和微生物组干预提供了年龄特异性证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为儿童 MP 肺炎的年龄特异性诊断方法、抗感染策略和基于微生物组的干预措施提供信息。儿科下呼吸道微生物群在多样性、微生物负荷和群落组成方面表现出明显的年龄依赖性变化。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是单中心回顾性分析,可能限制普遍性。该证据基于宏基因组测序,并得到统计分析的支持,提供了中等的置信水平。

papers.title: A novel adenovirus 19K/IX protein enhances infection by attenuating proteasomal degradation of tyrosine-ubiquitinated capsid protein IX
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are double-stranded DNA viruses that cause a wide range of diseases, including respiratory, ocular, and gastrointestinal infections. HAdVs rely extensively on alternative splicing to expand their coding capacity and regulate gene expression during infection. Using replication-competent epitope-tagged HAdV-C5 viruses, we investigated the function of a newly identified alternatively spliced viral transcript, 19K/IX, derived from the E1B19K and pIX genes. We show that the 19K/IX protein binds to and stabilizes the minor capsid protein IX (pIX), thereby attenuating its proteasomal degradation and enhancing the production of infectious viral progeny. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that pIX degradation is mediated by non-canonical ubiquitination of the conserved tyrosine residues Y14 and Y49, which confer pIX subnuclear localization and partially mediate its interaction with the PSMC3 subunit of the 26S proteasome. Collectively, our study identifies 19K/IX as a novel regulator of HAdV-C5 infection and suggests that non-canonical tyrosine ubiquitination contributes to the regulation of capsid protein IX stability. IMPORTANCE Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are clinically important pathogens and widely used as therapeutic tools. Because of their compact genomes, HAdVs use their genetic information very efficiently through alternative pre-mRNA processing. Here, we describe and characterize 19K/IX, a novel fusion protein generated by alternative splicing of two viral genes during infection. We demonstrate that 19K/IX stabilizes capsid protein IX by preventing its degradation, revealing a previously unrecognized strategy by which HAdVs ensure efficient production of new virus particles. These findings deepen our understanding of HAdV-C5 gene regulation and protein homeostasis and highlight the functional importance of non-canonical HAdV transcripts.

HAdVs rely extensively on alternative splicing to expand their coding capacity and regulate gene expression during infection. Using replication-competent epitope-tagged HAdV-C5 viruses, we investigated the function of a newly identified alternatively spliced viral transcript, 19K/IX, derived from the E1B19K and pIX genes. We show that the 19K/IX protein binds to and stabilizes the minor capsid protein IX (pIX), thereby attenuating its proteasomal degradation and enhancing the production of infectious viral progeny. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that pIX degradation is mediated by non-canonical ubiquitination of the conserved tyrosine residues Y14 and Y49, which confer pIX subnuclear localization and partially mediate its interaction with the PSMC3 subunit of the 26S proteasome. Collectively, our study identifies 19K/IX as a novel regulator of HAdV-C5 infection and suggests that non-canonical tyrosine ubiquitination contributes to the regulation of capsid protein IX stability. IMPORTANCE Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are clinically important pathogens and widely used as therapeutic tools. Because of their compact genomes, HAdVs use their genetic information very efficiently through alternative pre-mRNA processing. Here, we describe and characterize 19K/IX, a novel fusion protein generated by alternative splicing of two viral genes during infection. We demonstrate that 19K/IX stabilizes capsid protein IX by preventing its degradation, revealing a previously unrecognized strategy by which HAdVs ensure efficient production of new virus particles. These findings deepen our understanding of HAdV-C5 gene regulation and protein homeostasis and highlight the functional importance of non-canonical HAdV transcripts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究新鉴定的可变剪接病毒转录本 19K/IX 的功能,该转录本源自 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 中的 E1B19K 和 pIX 基因,人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是引起多种疾病的临床重要病原体。该研究解决了了解 HAdV 如何使用选择性剪接来扩展其编码能力并在感染过程中调节基因表达的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用具有复制能力的表位标记的 HAdV-C5 病毒来研究 人腺病毒 中 19K/IX 蛋白的功能。该研究旨在了解 19K/IX 在感染过程中的作用及其对传染性病毒后代产生的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用具有复制能力、表位标记的 HAdV-C5 病毒来研究 19K/IX 蛋白的功能。研究人员证明,19K/IX 蛋白可结合并稳定小衣壳蛋白 IX (pIX),从而减弱其蛋白酶体降解并增强感染性病毒后代的产生。
elements_zh.main_results: 从机制上讲,pIX 降解是通过保守酪氨酸残基 Y14 和 Y49 的非典型泛素化介导的,这赋予 pIX 亚核定位并部分介导其与 26S 蛋白酶体的 PSMC3 亚基的相互作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定 19K/IX 是 HAdV-C5 感染的新型调节因子,并表明非经典酪氨酸泛素化有助于衣壳蛋白 IX 稳定性的调节。这一发现加深了我们对 HAdV-C5 基因调控和蛋白质稳态的理解,并强调了非经典 HAdV 转录本的功能重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,非经典酪氨酸泛素化在衣壳蛋白 IX 稳定性的调节中发挥着作用,这可能对理解 HAdV-C5 感染以及开发针对腺病毒感染的治疗策略具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于使用单一 HAdV-C5 病毒,并且没有解决对其他 HAdV 物种的更广泛影响。由于研究范围有限,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是双链 DNA 病毒,可引起多种疾病,包括呼吸道、眼部和胃肠道感染。HAdV 广泛依赖选择性剪接来扩展其编码能力并在感染过程中调节基因表达。使用具有复制能力的表位标记的 HAdV-C5 病毒,我们研究了新鉴定的可变剪接病毒转录本 19K/IX(源自 E1B19K 和 pIX 基因)的功能。我们发现 19K/IX 蛋白结合并稳定小衣壳蛋白 IX (pIX),从而减弱其蛋白酶体降解并增强感染性病毒后代的产生。从机制上讲,我们证明 pIX 降解是通过保守酪氨酸残基 Y14 和 Y49 的非典型泛素化介导的,这赋予 pIX 亚核定位并部分介导其与 26S 蛋白酶体的 PSMC3 亚基的相互作用。总的来说,我们的研究确定 19K/IX 是 HAdV-C5 感染的新型调节因子,并表明非经典酪氨酸泛素化有助于衣壳蛋白 IX 稳定性的调节。重要性 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是临床上重要的病原体,广泛用作治疗工具。由于其紧凑的 基因组,HAdV 通过替代的前 mRNA 处理非常有效地利用其遗传信息。在这里,我们描述并表征了 19K/IX,这是一种新型融合蛋白,由感染过程中两个病毒基因的选择性剪接产生。我们证明 19K/IX 通过防止衣壳蛋白 IX 降解来稳定其,揭示了一种以前未被认识的策略,HAdV 通过该策略确保新病毒颗粒的高效生产。这些发现加深了我们对 HAdV-C5 基因调控和蛋白质稳态的理解,并强调了非经典 HAdV 转录本的功能重要性。

papers.title: Distinct epitope-specific memory kinetics within influenza B nucleoprotein shape long-term CD8+ T cell differentiation in the lung
papers.abstract: CD8 + T cell memory inflation, originally described during murine cytomegalovirus infection, is characterized by the progressive accumulation of antigen-specific memory T cells that retain effector-like features rather than undergoing gradual contraction. Here, using intranasal immunization of CB6F1 mice with a recombinant adenoviral vector expressing influenza B nucleoprotein (NP), we identified two immunodominant epitopes within a single antigen. Whereas D b /BNP 352 -specific CD8 + T cells dominated during the effector phase, D d /BNP 166 -specific cells progressively increased during late memory, consistent with memory inflation. papers.title: Computationally designed multisubtype epigraph vaccine confers broad-spectrum protection against H1 and H3 swine influenza A viruses
papers.abstract: H1 and H3 subtype swine influenza A viruses (IAV-S) threaten global agricultural economies and pose zoonotic risks, yet conventional vaccines provide limited protection against their vast antigenic diversity. Here, we developed a multisubtype vaccine utilizing adenoviral vectors expressing computationally designed H1 and H3 epigraph hemagglutinin (HA) immunogens. In mice, this All-in-One formulation elicited balanced humoral and cellular immunity and demonstrated neutralizing breadth against diverse IAV-S isolates compared to a commercially available vaccine. The multisubtype delivery system elicited concurrent immunity and protection against both H1 and H3 subtypes. The All-in-One vaccine conferred protection against heterologous H1 and H3 challenges and did not exacerbate clinical morbidity characteristic of mismatched vaccination. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of computationally optimized and multiplexed vaccines providing broad-spectrum protection against evolving influenza viruses without compromising safety.

papers.title: Freshwater Microbiomes Shape Viral Inactivation in Continuous Cultures
papers.abstract: In freshwater environments, bacteria are known to enhance the removal and inactivation of human viruses. Rates of inactivation differ across freshwater ecosystems, though the influence of community diversity and composition on this process remain poorly understood. Here, we used dilution-to-extinction to generate 64 distinct freshwater communities from three lakes and three aquifers. After establishing freshwater communities in chemostat cultures, each community was challenged with two viruses, coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2. Both viruses were inactivated more rapidly in lake-derived than in groundwater-derived communities, and adenovirus was inactivated faster than coxsackievirus in both freshwater types. Community-level parameters (e.g., cell numbers, richness) were not significant predictors of viral inactivation. Instead, differential abundance analyses identified bacterial OTUs associated with inactivation: Acidovorax sp. were associated across sources and Brevundimonas sp., Sphingopyxis sp., and Hydrogenophaga sp. showed source-specific associations. Together, these findings provide new insights into the ecological drivers of viral stability and suggest that viral inactivation may depend more strongly on specific microbial taxa and their environmental context than on overall community diversity. Identifying these associations improves our understanding of the factors governing viral stability in freshwater environments.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how community diversity and composition in freshwater ecosystems influence the inactivation of human adenoviruses, addressing a knowledge gap in viral stability in these environments.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used dilution-to-extinction to generate 64 distinct freshwater communities from three lakes and three aquifers, focusing on the inactivation of coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2 in chemostat cultures.
analysis_en.methods: Freshwater communities were established in chemostat cultures and challenged with two viruses, coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2. Differential abundance analyses identified bacterial OTUs associated with inactivation, including Acidovorax sp., Brevundimonas sp., Sphingopyxis sp., and Hydrogenophaga sp.
analysis_en.main_results: Both coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2 were inactivated more rapidly in lake-derived than in groundwater-derived communities, with adenovirus inactivating faster than coxsackievirus in both freshwater types. Community-level parameters were not significant predictors of viral inactivation.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that specific microbial taxa, rather than overall community diversity, play a crucial role in viral inactivation in freshwater environments, providing new insights into the ecological drivers of viral stability.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results improve our understanding of the factors governing viral stability in freshwater environments, which can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment strategies for adenovirus infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design limitations, such as the use of chemostat cultures, may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the controlled nature of the experiments.

papers.title_zh: 淡水微生物组在连续培养中影响病毒失活
papers.source_body_en: In freshwater environments, bacteria are known to enhance the removal and inactivation of human viruses. Rates of inactivation differ across freshwater ecosystems, though the influence of community diversity and composition on this process remain poorly understood. Here, we used dilution-to-extinction to generate 64 distinct freshwater communities from three lakes and three aquifers. After establishing freshwater communities in chemostat cultures, each community was challenged with two viruses, coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2. Both viruses were inactivated more rapidly in lake-derived than in groundwater-derived communities, and adenovirus was inactivated faster than coxsackievirus in both freshwater types. Community-level parameters (e.g., cell numbers, richness) were not significant predictors of viral inactivation. Instead, differential abundance analyses identified bacterial OTUs associated with inactivation: Acidovorax sp. were associated across sources and Brevundimonas sp., Sphingopyxis sp., and Hydrogenophaga sp. showed source-specific associations. Together, these findings provide new insights into the ecological drivers of viral stability and suggest that viral inactivation may depend more strongly on specific microbial taxa and their environmental context than on overall community diversity. Identifying these associations improves our understanding of the factors governing viral stability in freshwater environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 在淡水环境中,已知细菌可以增强人类病毒的去除和灭活作用。尽管群落多样性和组成对该过程的影响仍知之甚少,但不同淡水生态系统的失活率有所不同。在这里,我们利用稀释至灭绝的方法从三个湖泊和三个含水层生成了 64 个不同的淡水群落。在恒化培养物中建立淡水群落后,每个群落都受到两种病毒的攻击,即柯萨奇病毒 B5 和 人腺病毒 2。这两种病毒在湖泊来源的群落中比在地下水来源的群落中失活更快,并且在两种淡水类型中,腺病毒比柯萨奇病毒失活更快。群落水平参数(例如细胞数量、丰富度)并不是病毒失活的显着预测因子。相反,差异丰度分析确定了与失活相关的细菌 OTU:Acidovorax sp。跨来源与短波单胞菌属 (Brevundimonas sp.)、鞘氨醇单胞菌属 (Sphingopyxis sp.) 和氢噬菌属 (Hydrogenophaga sp.) 相关。显示出特定来源的关联。总之,这些发现为病毒稳定性的生态驱动因素提供了新的见解,并表明病毒失活可能更依赖于特定的微生物类群及其环境背景,而不是整体群落多样性。识别这些关联可以提高我们对淡水环境中控制病毒稳定性的因素的理解。

Here's which viruses are circulating In emergency rooms, cases of acute upper respiratory infections, sore throats, pneumonia and bronchitis are being reported, as of data through Halloween. By Alex Dvorak • Published November 9, 2026 • Updated on November 9, 2026 at 6:49 pm Log in or create a free profile to save articles BOOKMARKER 0:00 Pause 0:01 / 2:56 Unmute Subtitles EnglishNoneSettings ShareToggle Fullscreen it’s waiting to get more information before deciding NBC Universal, Inc. While flu season is opening up, an infectious disease doctor at UChicago explains it may not be what’s making most people sick right now, as Kate Chappell reports. Does it feel like everyone is sick right now? You're not alone. Stream NBC 5 for free, 24/7, wherever you are. WATCH HERE According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, a number of respiratory viruses are showing "unusual trends" for this time of year. In a recent report, the agency said four illnesses in particular are "have recently gotten attention in the news or are showing signs of increased activity." In emergency rooms, cases of acute upper respiratory infections, sore throats, pneumonia and bronchitis are being reported, as of data through Halloween. In some cases, the viruses are climbing at surprising rates. The latest surge has even led a suburban Chicago hospital to limit support people waiting in its emergency room as respiratory virus cases climb. Health & Wellness Health Nov 11 When do you need antibiotics for sickness? Doctor weighs in Health Nov 11 Do you need an antibiotic? Doctor weighs in on when to seek out medication Here's a look at what's going around right now, according to the CDC: Group A strep Group A strep infections began to rise as kids returned to school this fall, but have started stabilizing since, the CDC reported. "Most of these reports have involved strep throat or scarlet fever, two infections caused by group A strep bacteria," the agency noted. "These bacteria can also cause serious infections, like streptococcal toxic shock syndrome and necrotizing fasciitis ('flesh-eating disease')." Rhinovirus/Enterovirus and Respiratory Adenovirus (HAdV) Rhinovirus and enterovirus cases are "elevated nationally" and respiratory adenovirus (HAdV) is "elevated in some regions of the country," CDC data showed. While the agency said such trends are "expected for this time of year," they could be behind a surge in coughs, fevers, nasal congestion and shortness of breath. More severe infections could also lead to bronchitis or pneumonia. "There are no vaccines available to the public for these illnesses. Prevention measures include hand washing, cleaning surfaces, and staying home when sick," the CDC reported. In the Chicago area specifically, medical experts have reported a rise in rhino enterovirus being seen. "You probably have rhino enterovirus, and probably not influenza. There is a pretty nasty round of rhino entero going around right now," Dr. Emily Landon, the executive medical director of Infection Prevention and Control at UChicago, told NBC Chicago in October. Mycoplasma pneumoniae While cases are low in most the U.S., according to emergency department visits and testing, respiratory infections caused by the bacteria mycoplasma pneumoniae, also known as walking pneumonia, could be behind a chest hold or even cases of pneumonia, the CDC noted. Pertussis Whooping cough is a highly contagious and easily spread respiratory infection. While cases are lower than the levels seen during a post-pandemic peak, the CDC said it continues to circulate. "Babies younger than 1 year are at highest risk of severe disease and complications. The best way to prevent complications from whooping cough is to get vaccinated," the CDC wrote. supplementary_news.excerpt: 目前,江苏省符合条件的家庭可以使用职工医保个人账户历年结余资金,通过家庭共济方式支付婴幼儿RSV预防单抗相关费用,为家长及时做好宝宝的RSV预防提供了更加灵活的支付选择。“之前听说其他孩子因RSV感染住院,我们就想着早点带宝宝来做好预防。“有家长坦言,“这次比较惊喜的是工作人员告诉我们还可以用医保家庭共济支付,账户里的余额就能用来支付孩子的预防费用,操作很方便。给宝宝做好预防,我们心里也更踏实了。
